The gas pressure provided to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tube(s).

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I am not associated with "Weber" so bare that in mind when reading my/this review.This review is about the Weber Spirit II - My wife and I have owned Weber grills, 2 - charcoal kettles and most recently we purchased a Weber Spirit II (2 - burner) propane grill since the mid 60's; so you might say that a Weber kettle grill is a long time performer and we look forward to our Weber propane grill taking us to the finish line.  Weber products are still built from quality materials, very professionally designed and engineered.  We own Weber accessories and they are also quality products.  We have gotten a lot of mileage from Weber products as we kept them "clean" and stored properly.  If you just do those two things you will be very happy with anything Weber makes.  Additionally, Weber's website and email newsletter are both tremendous sources of "anything grilling", from recipes to maintenance. When you shop grills,  Weber's are pricey, but "not becasue of the name", you are actually getting good value for your hard earned money and won't be disappointed.  We buy Weber products mainly from our local "Ace hardware" store whose clerk's are a joy to work with.
Results.Title: Weber is "good stuff" from any angle.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
